about: PMR Law is a personal injury firm with offices in Houston and Conroe.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 2 listings, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours, photo count and description come from the Places API. The services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way.

subs.label: Local presence
subs.evidence: 2 operational Google Business Profile listings · 10 or more photos, which is where the API stops counting · 5 categories, hours published, which almost every listing here has and so separates nobody · the services list, Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the Places API does not expose, and NAP consistency across citations and local-pack rank have no source here, so the rest of this sub-factor leaves the scale rather than being scored as unearned
